verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Shopify's AI-related offerings are developer-facing: an AI Toolkit for coding tools (shopify-docs-8/35/39), MCP/UCP infrastructure for building external agents (shopify-docs-6/7/34/44), and a vague marketing line 'Design fast with AI' (shopify-docs-24). None of this documents a built-in AI assistant inside the Shopify product itself (e.g., an admin-embedded assistant like Sidekick) that a merchant/user could delegate tasks to. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation of an in-product AI assistant UI, its task-delegation capabilities, or hands-on/community confirmation that merchants use it inside the admin.
